metadata.description: Design real, editable artifacts on Moda from any coding agent: decks, documents, social creative, diagrams, hosted websites, brand-true designs, and precise canvas edits over the moda CLI.

plugins.name: moda
plugins.description: Moda's skill roster — moda-core plus twelve format skills (deck, document, social, diagram, chart, mockup, website, video, image, audio, brand, edit) with their recipe children, four workspace helpers, and the /moda router. Requires the moda CLI; Step 0 in every skill checks it and never installs anything itself.
